name: Guardian Enforcer
purpose: Deterministic release gate for CardNest programs, agents, code changes, card data, and production assets.
principles: security and user privacy before automation
automaticBlockers: unexpected clan, rarity, or battle class
production card asset reused by a different card
Season One card silently changed to released
Season One card silently changed to pack eligible
humanApprovalRequired: switch Stripe or another payment provider to live mode
change a Season One card to released
make a Season One card pack eligible
failureMode: fail closed for canonical integrity, release-state, exact duplicate production assets, and exposed secrets; report warnings for creative near-collisions requiring review
